body:
IDUNA's POST /api/v1/brawlpit-checkpoints/match-result (RecordMatchResult, commit 0d787ca) is the only thing that ever moves a checkpoint's Elo off its inherited value. Fixed the last real blocker: rl_registry.py never actually implemented record_match_result despite rl_evaluate.py/rl_bot_pool.py importing it -- added it and live-verified end to end against production (checkpoint 23 1500->1516, checkpoint 24 1500->1484, confirmed via a fresh GET).

⚓ ☃
title: S421-04: real match-result recording moves real checkpoint Elo
